scripts.start: heap=8096; for file in "/sys/fs/cgroup$(sed -n 's/^0:://p' /proc/self/cgroup 2>/dev/null)/memory.max" /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes; do limit=$(cat "$file" 2>/dev/null); case $limit in ''|*[!0-9]*|????????????????*) ;; *) heap=$((limit / 1048576 * 3 / 4)); [ $heap -ge 256 ] || heap=256; [ $heap -le 8096 ] || heap=8096; break ;; esac; done; export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=$heap${NODE_OPTIONS:+ $NODE_OPTIONS}" && exec node --require Common/Server/Utils/TsNode/PrecompiledSourceMaps.js Index.js
scripts.clear-modules: rm -rf node_modules && rm package-lock.json && npm install
